source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Add baking soda to all factory wastewater before discharge.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Add organic matter to acidic soil.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Clear factory wastewater needs no neutralisation.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Apply neutralisation reasoning to ant bites, acidic or basic soil, and factory waste in water. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names.
